claim_summary: For every integer \(n\ge0\), the exact harmonic orbit \(\gamma(t)=(\cos t,-\sin t)\) of the Adjaï–Akande–Yehossou–Monsia family \(\ddot x+x(\dot x^2+\dot x\sum_{\ell=0}^{n}x^{2\ell}+x^2-1)\dot x+x^{2n+3}=0\) has both planar Floquet multipliers exactly equal to \(1\). With \(R=x^2+y^2-1\) and \(S_n(x)=\sum_{\ell=0}^{n}x^{2\ell}\), the full planar system satisfies the exact defect law \(\dot R=-2xy(y+S_n(x))R\); the normal period exponent on the unit circle is zero. Hence the harmonic cycle is nonhyperbolic for every \(n\ge0\) and cannot be exponentially attracting or repelling. The claim does not determine isolation, semistability, a surrounding periodic annulus, or higher-order nonlinear stability.
integrity: The proof is exact and analytic. A dependency-free checker replays the polynomial factorization for finite indices only as an implementation check; the all-index statement follows from the written geometric-series proof. No numerical trajectory is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only equation (1.8) of the cited article and only its first Floquet variation. Unit transverse multiplier does not decide isolation, semistability, periodic-annulus structure, or higher-order return-map coefficients.
title: Exact Floquet neutrality of the harmonic cycle in the Adjaï–Akande–Yehossou–Monsia family
